research_role: test one simple new-high/new-low breadth-exhaustion engine economically distinct from Industry Diffusion continuation and downside-extreme participation

economic_hypothesis.mechanism: when the broad balance of 60-session new highs minus new lows is unusually depressed versus its own causal history, selling breadth may be exhausted and a five-session broad rebound may follow
economic_hypothesis.independence: the trigger is the accepted market-wide new-high/new-low breadth state; it is not downside-limit participation, Industry Diffusion, Low-MAX, support, candle, or Champion membership
economic_hypothesis.prior_evidence_boundary: MKT-STATE-ECON-SCREEN-001 found a negative relationship between this breadth state and subsequent five-day market response across years; it did not test this executable low-state basket

frozen_strategy.signal: coordinate <= 0.20 at completed day-t close; one event on every qualifying completed session
frozen_strategy.activation: first causally available 504-observation PIT coordinate, expected 2020-07-28
frozen_strategy.stock_universe: exact causal daily-feature-panel rows available by day-t close; this panel already requires prior-20 average amount >= CNY 50m
frozen_strategy.selection: 20 highest prior-20-session average-amount stocks, descending avg_amount20 then symbol
frozen_strategy.selection_role: capacity-only broad basket; no return score or outcome-trained rank
frozen_strategy.entry: next legal market-session open; blocked names are not backfilled
frozen_strategy.holding: five market sessions from entry to due open, with unchanged QD-010 pre-effective and legal-fill handling
frozen_strategy.event_capital: minimum of available cash and one-fifth pre-entry NAV

sequential_protocol.full_replay: run exact 2020-07-28 through 2023-12-29 only when both gates pass; no rule change

required_diagnostics: signal dates, planned and completed trades, entry coverage and capital-skipped entries
total and annualized return, maximum drawdown, Sharpe, Calmar and calendar returns
severe-loss incidence, turnover, breadth, industry concentration and capacity
daily-return correlation and signal-date overlap with frozen Industry-Consensus Q1
prohibited: state threshold, new-high/new-low horizon, basket size, liquidity window, capital divisor, or holding-period search
stock return, momentum, Low-MAX, industry, support, candle, VWAP, panic, or post-shock recovery rank
signal onset, cooldown, persistence, multiple-event suppression, or habitat search
validation outcome access before every generation requirement passes
combination with Strategy A before Strategy B independently passes
OOS, independent-confirmation, production, or live claim
